content.title: What Is Snowflake - Breaking Down What Snowflake Is, How Snowflake Credits Work And More
content.text: Snowflake is a popular choice when it comes to building your data platform. I actually recall the first time I was introduced to Snowflake it was at a tech event that I assumed was a data meet-up and low and behold it was a sales pitch(essentially) but hey, there was free food. Jokes aside, in this video we'll talk about Snowflake, and answer questions like how does Snowflake credits work, different snowflake features and more! If you're looking for help loading data into Snowflake, you can try out Estuary - https://estuary.dev/?utm_source=Seatt...
